SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900
  AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );	----- bird -----	thrombosis_prediction
